annotations.title: Read planning progress or a saved result

description: Read a saved planning calculation. section selects what is returned: status (default) for progress, input for the fixed inputs it used, list for a lightweight overview of returned routes and scope, reading for user-facing route details (conditions, preparations, dependencies, time, costs and sources), goal for one selected goal and its dependency closure, or result for raw detail. A status read waits up to ten seconds and, while the calculation is queued or running, returns retry_after_seconds; read status again with the same calculation_id until it is succeeded or failed. An interrupted read does not need a new calculation. Saved metadata includes calculation_scope, continuation_of and route_summary; route_summary reports, for ordinary and forecast 189 routes, how many have a route diagram and how many have a conditional PR date, plus forecast status and completeness. Start the overview with section=list and result_path="". To open a route or condition, copy its returned reading_ref or reading_sections section and path into section and result_path. Use next_cursor for further pages at the same section and path, and reset cursor when either changes. A single value too large to return gives result_value_too_large (413); a smaller limit does not change that. For a selected goal use section=goal with goal_path copied from its raw goal pointer; result_path is relative to that goal detail. Reset cursor when changing goal_path. result_list, result_reading and result_goal schemas describe the returned fields. Shared /records/pr_forecast/ and /records/processing_statistic/ references are read with section=reading in the same calculation; reuse identical references without expanding them per route. Goal pages may contain kind=shared entries: resolve record_id from the records map or an intact previously read record in the same fixed calculation. Missing definitions are unread, not empty. Read the selected goal first and reuse predictions/statistics already in its dependencies before requesting separate evidence. Group independent reads of known paths in one tool round. Preserve distinct goals and unread pages. scope_gaps lists directions not explored because a preference is undecided, which is different from ineligibility. Unknown scores, dates and costs stay unknown, a succeeded calculation is not a visa decision, and reading never starts a new calculation. Requires the authenticated One U Education account and declared planning scope; credentials and user identity are never tool arguments.

goal_path.description: Required only for section=goal. Copy the raw goal pointer from the goal catalogue: /plan_graphs/{ref}/goals/{index} or /forecast_search/routes/{index}/plan_graph/goals/{index}. result_path then selects inside this goal detail; reset cursor when changing goal.

result_path.description: Empty string starts the overview. Copy each returned reading_ref or reading_sections reference section and path into section and result_path; reading_sections may target reading or result. detail_path belongs to raw result. For section=goal, result_path is relative to the selected goal detail. Reset cursor when changing section, path or goal_path. An inline entry is complete only within its selected projection.

section.description: status is progress; list is a lightweight overview of returned choices and scope; reading is expanded user-facing detail, opened through a returned reading_ref or reading_sections reference; goal is one target with its dependency closure selected by goal_path; result is raw detail; input is the fixed calculation input. result_list, result_reading and result_goal describe these projections.
